  'ug_disciplines:Amityapi/GetDiscipline?stype=g' \\

  'campus_courses:Amityapi/GetallCoursebasedonCampus'; do

A Full-time Ph.D. scholar shall mean a candidate devoting full time for completing the requirements of the program and a part-time Ph.D. scholar shall mean a candidate who is devoting a part of his time towards the pursuit of the program while discharging his official/employment obligations.<br />Ph.D. full-time is for a minimum of 3 years and Ph.D. part-time is for a minimum of 3.5 years. from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import re,sys
s=BeautifulSoup(open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf-8',errors='replace'),'html.parser')
for li in s.select('li.item'):
    em=li.find('em')
    if not em: continue
    noida=[a for a in li.select('a.campus-link') if a.get_text(' ',strip=True).lower()=='noida']
    if not noida: continue
    full=em.get_text(' ',strip=True)
    m=re.search(r'\\s+\\((["'^()]*(?:'"\\(["'^)]*'"\\)["'^()]*)?)'"\\)\\s*"'$'"',full)
    if m:
        name=full[:m.start()].strip(); duration=m.group(1).strip()
    else:
        name=full; duration=''
    print('\\t'.join([noida[0].get('data-cd',''), name, duration, full]))

 Applications for admission to a Ph.D. program at Amity University are accepted twice a year, for January and July sessions.

Applicants who apply for multiple PhD Programs via multiple forms (and to more than one Amity Campuses) need to themselves ensure they appear in the selection process of the two or more applied programs in one or more campuses on DIFFERENT PET/selection process dates. 
 Eligible candidates will be required to appear in the Selection Process consisting of PET (Ph.D. Entrance Test) /and an Interview round as per UGC’s PhD Guidelines. PET Exempted candidates, exempted as per criteria given in section ’eligibility criteria’ will appear for Interview only 
 The Amity PhD Entrance Test ( APET) shall be of one and half hour duration (i.e. 90 minutes), consisting of 100 MCQs of 100 marks in total and with no negative marking. The Entrance Test will have two Sections (administered in one go), as mentioned here under:
 Section 2 shall be Program / SubjectSpecific as per applied Ph.D. program of the applicant. 
	 This section shall be divided into two parts – 25 questions shall be purely from the PhD Program subject & 25 questions from either the PhD Program subject or any related and offered allied field. Difficulty level is UGC-CSIR-NET, GATE etc./ Masters level of the subject
